question: Which of the following airports is India's first to be completely powered by solar energy?

options.text: Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj International Airport (CSMIA), Mumbai

solution:
The correct answer is__** Cochin International Airport Limited (CIAL), Kerala.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ** Cochin International Airport Limited (CIAL), Kerala:-**

 
 
• It is the first airport in India to be built under a Public Private Partnership (PPP) model.
 
• **It is also the first ever airport in the world to be fully powered by solar energy.**
 
• CIAL is** owned and operated by a public limited company called Cochin International Airport Limited, **which has around 18,000 shareholders from 29 countries.
 
• The** Government of Kerala holds a 33.36% stake **in the company, making it the single largest investor.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ** Kempe Gowda International Airport (KIA), Bangalore:-**

 
 
• **It is an international airport serving Bangalore, the capital of Karnataka, India. **
 
• It is named after Kempe Gowda I, the founder of Bangalore.
 
• KIA is the third busiest airport in India by passenger traffic, air traffic movements, and domestic and total cargo handled.
 
• It is also the 29th busiest airport in Asia. In the financial year 2021-22, the airport handled around 16.2 million passengers and 411,550 tonnes of cargo.
 
 
 
• **Indira Gandhi International Airport (IGIA), Delhi:-**
 
 
• **It is the largest and busiest airport in India. **
 
• It is named after Indira Gandhi, the former Prime Minister of India.
 
 
 
• **Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj International Airport (CSMIA), Mumbai:-**
 
 
• **It is the second busiest airport in India in terms of total and international passenger traffic. **
 
• It is located about 30 kilometers north of the city center.
